In the matter of Arihant Retail Private Limited 
 
 
Regulation 39(4) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India 
(Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporat e Persons) Regulations, 
2016 (CIRP Regulations, 2016) by the Resolution Professional of the 
Corporate Debtor viz.,  ARIHANT RETAIL PRIVATE LIMITED seeking 
approval of resolution plan submitted by the Successful Resolution 
Applicant (SRA) viz., POTHYS RETAIL PRIVATE LIMITED seeking the 
following reliefs:  
A. Allow the present application; 
B. Approve the Resolution Plan dated 27.02.2026 & addendum dated 
20.07.2026 submitted by the Pothys Retail Pvt.  Ltd, (SRA), as 
approved by the Committee of Creditors of the Corporate Debtor, 
Arihant Retail Private Limited, with 100% voting share in favour 
under Section 30(4) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, 
after considering its feasibility and viability in terms of Section 31 of 
the Code. 
C. Grant and allow the reliefs, concessions, and waivers, sought under 
Clause 26 (Page 48 to 55 of the Resolution plan dated 27.02.2026) of 
the Resolution plan dated 27.02.2026  to the extent deemed fit and 
proper by this Tribunal. 
D. In terms of the Resolution Plan, direct for the appointment of the 
Monitoring Committee.  
E. To pass such further orders/reliefs as may be deemed fit and proper 
in the facts and circumstances of the case and thus render justice.

                    A. Allow the present application;

                    B.  Approve the  Resolution Plan dated 27.02.2026 & addendum dated
                        20.07.2026  submitted  by  the  Pothys  Retail  Pvt.                 Ltd,  (SRA),  as
                        approved  by  the  Committee  of  Creditors  of  the  Corporate  Debtor,
                        Arihant Retail Private Limited, with 100%  voting  share in  favour
                        under Section 30(4) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016,
                        after considering its feasibility and viability in terms of Section 31 of
                        the Code.

                    C.  Grant and allow the reliefs, concessions, and waivers, sought under
                        Clause 26 (Page 48 to 55 of the Resolution plan dated 27.02.2026) of
                        the  Resolution  plan  dated  27.02.2026 to  the  extent  deemed  fit  and
                        proper by this Tribunal.


                    D. In  terms  of  the  Resolution  Plan,  direct  for  the  appointment  of  the
                        Monitoring Committee.

                    E.  To pass such further orders/reliefs as may be deemed fit and proper
                        in the facts and circumstances of the case and thus render justice.
